# Cases whose comparison with the node oracle is not "ok" (see expect_test.go).
# id<TAB>status<TAB>reason
vl_1756	ok@pango-1.48|differ@pango-1.57	platform: the only text is U+1F415, an emoji. On Linux node-canvas (Pango 1.48) measures it with Noto Emoji's advance (25.39 px at 20px, as the engine does); on macOS (Pango 1.57) every emoji presentation sequence measures exactly one em (11 px at 11px), so the label is narrower and the autosized view one pixel narrower
vl_1605	ok@arm64|differ@x64	platform: a log colour scale's legend gradient stop at 14 is (log(14) - log(8)) / (log(24.8) - log(8)); V8 on x86-64 rounds Math.log(14) to 2.6390573296152584 and V8 on arm64 (which jsmath follows, fusing multiply-adds as clang does there) to 2.639057329615259, so one stop offset differs in its last digits where node runs on x86-64 (jsmath with the fusions removed gives x64's 0.4946214809497679). The tolerance hid it until offsets were compared exactly (C66)
